note: Supports exactly two releases: the npm latest release 0.1.5-rc.3 (the default host) and the npm next release 0.1.7-rc.1. Round 28 (2026-09-24) dropped 0.1.2-rc.1, 0.1.3-alpha.2, 0.1.5-rc.1 and 0.1.6-alpha.2. See docs/validation.md for the gates run against checkouts built from both release tags; a matching version string alone does not establish compatibility with another checkout.
